feature_profiles.name: Upload va Gan Mockup cho Product Base
feature_profiles.user_goal: La owner, upload anh mockup moi hoac chon tu media library, va gan cho product base/variant de preview san pham.

actors.permission_observed: Upload va gan 1 mockup thanh cong tren product base 3203, khong gap access-denied.

entry_points.precondition: dang o trang edit cua product base

capabilities.name: Upload mockup moi
capabilities.description: Luong 4 buoc tach roi: (1) POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url; (2) PUT thang len CDN (khong qua backend teeinblue); (3) POST /api/mockup-layers/by-temporary-file; (4) POST /api/products/{id}/mockups.

capabilities.name: Media library modal
capabilities.description: Chon anh co san; category qua GET /api/mockup-layer-categories, danh sach anh qua GET /api/mockup-layers (phan trang offset).

capabilities.name: Trang thai Rendering sau khi gan
capabilities.description: Card mockup hien 'Rendering', xu ly bat dong bo phia server; run nay khong cho toi khi render xong.

capabilities.name: Modal 'Assign mockups'
capabilities.description: 2 cot 'Select variants'/'Select mockups' kem Select all moi cot; run nay chi mo roi Cancel.

observed_behavior.statement: Buoc PUT upload binary di thang len oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com bang presigned URL, KHONG qua backend teeinblue.

{userId} trong path buoc 1 (POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url) = users.id (266), KHONG phai staffs.id (sub=273) - route DUY NHAT trong toan bo capture co id nguoi dung nam trong path.
Media library dung phan trang offset (?page&per_page), khac cursor pagination cua /products chinh.
Sau gan, khong co evidence polling/webhook nao cho toi khi render xong (portal-explorer dem polling=0 trong toan capture); chi co text huong dan 'reload after a few minutes'.
Modal Assign mockups run nay chi mo roi Cancel, chua thuc su gan mockup cho variant nao.

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner); chua biet role khac co bi gioi han upload/gan mockup hay khong.

portal.item: /products/{id}/edit, section Mockup + media library modal + Assign mockups modal

api.item: PUT presigned URL len oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com (bo thu ba)

dependencies.relation: Assign mockups gan mockup cho tung variant

risks.risk: TTL, scope (bucket/prefix) va gioi han kich thuoc file cua presigned upload URL chua quan sat duoc vi response bi redact hoan toan theo redaction policy - khong the danh gia rui ro (URL co the bi lo/tai su dung) tu run nay.
userId trong path buoc 1 dung users.id thay vi staffs.id (route duy nhat khac biet nay) - rui ro nham lan dinh danh neu co logic phan quyen dua tren path param o tang khac.
